messages:
alex: Heads-up: mid-rollout change for FF-ml-model-routing. Planning a rapid pin + 10% -> 30% ramp over the next 30m. Will run preflight then flip cohorts. Hold window is 15:45-16:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: preflight started for rollout ff/ml-routing v2 -> v2b. Running healthchecks and telemetry smoke. (/deploy preflight ff/ml-routing --variant v2b)

deploy-bot: preflight result: OK — latency p95 within SLO, error-rate baseline within 0.01% of expected.

oliver: @alex quick Q: are we pinning traffic to model v2b for all customers in the cohort or only internal/testing orgs?

alex: pin for external cohorts A+B (10% of traffic). internal/testing orgs set to 100% already. We want to monitor real-user variance before widening.

maya: remind me what the rollback path is if we see a quality regression?

sam: rollback plan: immediate unpin + route back to v2. Run quick compare evals (evals/realtime-qa) and then open a revert PR to the routing config. I have the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-rollback (follow step 2->4).

katie: timezone note: 15:45 UTC is 8:45 PT — fine for eng on-call. tagging @jen_sre for ops watch.

jen_sre: watching. if error-rate > 0.5% above baseline or latency p95 degrades by > 30% we PAUSE. Also if request-mediated QA fails on the sample set we stop.

alex: plan: flip to 10% now, hold 10m, check dashboards + live QA. if green -> 30% for 10m -> 60% then full. If any gate fails we fast-unpin to v2 instantly.

oliver: can we add a short-circuit in the router to force drain to v2 for a user segment? want to limit blast radius if we see hallucination spike.

maya: added routing override flag: routing.force_drain_segment = ["segment_x"] — will be ready if needed.

deploy-bot: toggle request accepted: ff/ml-routing set_cohort "cohort-A" 10% by alex at 3412345690

deploy-bot: post-toggle checks: health ok, qps within expected variance.

sam: running quick evals now (sample size 200). ETA 5m.

jen_sre: seeing a slight uptick in prompt timeouts from a subset of EU nodes ~+12% — marking as watch.

alex: hold on ramp until sam's evals and jen_sre confirm node issue cleared. pausing ramp at 10%.

katie: noted. I'll update release notes draft: "Mid-rollout: staged pin to v2b cohort A. Paused at 10% to investigate EU latency bump."

oliver: +1 :thumbsup:

sam: evals show no regression on quality metrics, FP rate unchanged. EU node timeouts look transient, ops is draining the node pool now.

jen_sre: draining done, timeouts back to baseline. ready to continue if you want to proceed.

alex: OK proceeding to 30% now. will ping here after the next hold. Thanks all. :rocket:
